'''Bastian Winkelhaus Asteroid Sanctuary''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls76.htm Asteroid Sanctuary], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002900/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls76.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
